name: scaffolding
description: A guide to setting up, building out, and extending the repos across Fabrizio's fleet, gated on verified ownership. An owned repo adopts his conventions and standards plugins; a fork or a third-party repo gets nothing adopted without explicit consent. Routes to the shared CI and to the helper repos — github-workflows, claude-plugins, terraform-github — adding each as it is needed. Always on, and never adopted by a repository: it reasons about a repo from outside it.
